title: Great Book Chapter 71 — Potato Fermentation and Distillation Chemistry Audit
status: book-derived food/fermentation chemistry archaeology; scientific correction layer, not a production protocol
source: The Great Book Of Potato2.odt, Chapter 71 'Turn Water (and Potato) into Vodka', parsed page 467
importance: This is a small but genuine chemistry/biotechnology branch outside the project's physics-heavy science tree. The historical chapter describes potato mash, yeast, fermentation and distillation, but omits the critical starch-to-sugar conversion step and treats distillation metaphorically as extracting a potato 'spirit'.
historical_chain: potato + added sugar + water + yeast -> fermentation -> distillation -> vodka/preservation/cleaning symbolism

scientific_audit.starch_problem: Saccharomyces yeast does not efficiently ferment intact potato starch directly. Potato starch must first be hydrolyzed/saccharified into fermentable sugars by suitable enzymatic or biological processes. Adding table sugar/corn syrup can drive fermentation, but then much of the fermentable carbon is the added sugar rather than potato starch.
scientific_audit.schematic_starch_hydrolysis: (C6H10O5)_n + n H2O -> n C6H12O6 (idealized glucose-unit bookkeeping; real starch hydrolysis produces mixtures/intermediates depending on enzymes/process)
scientific_audit.fermentation: C6H12O6 -> 2 C2H5OH + 2 CO2 + biochemical energy/biomass side products
scientific_audit.mass_balance_rule: Carbon entering as starch-derived sugar, added sugar and other fermentable substrates should be tracked separately if the goal is to quantify how much ethanol is truly potato-derived.
scientific_audit.distillation: Distillation separates components according to vapor-liquid equilibrium and volatility; it does not chemically create ethanol and is not literally extracting a metaphysical essence.
scientific_audit.purity_boundary: Ethanol-water mixtures have non-ideal phase behavior, so repeated equilibrium separation is not equivalent to unlimited purification by simple distillation.
scientific_audit.safety_boundary: Any practical distillation process involves fire, pressure, vapor, contamination and legal/regulatory issues. The science archive should record the chemistry without presenting the old chapter as a safe operating recipe.

starchforce_connection.chain: Spudlight/solar input -> photosynthetic carbon fixation -> carbohydrate/starch storage -> enzymatic mobilization/saccharification -> microbial fermentation -> ethanol/CO2
starchforce_connection.scientific_value: This gives another ordinary-material interpretation of Starchforce: stored chemical carbon can be mobilized into a different chemical-energy carrier through biochemical transformation.
starchforce_connection.boundary: These are mass/chemical-energy flows, not evidence for a new fundamental force.

research_upgrade: Distinguish substrate identity: potato starch versus externally added fermentable sugar.
Measure conversion yield, carbon balance and fermentation kinetics instead of treating transformation qualitatively.
Model starch hydrolysis and fermentation as coupled biochemical stages rather than one step.
Keep food chemistry, preservation/cleaning claims and spiritual/alchemical symbolism in separate fields.
